snippet.title: Bloomies - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Hatch eggs to breed the cutest and strongest Bloomies your taskbar has ever seen! Decorate their world to make them feel at home. But beware, dark shadow Bloomies are waiting to take over your taskbar. Bloomies is a monster collector game with farming elements that runs independently on your taskbar. Use your computer as usual-the Bloomies will happily continue living below.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075630/Bloomies/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
